title: for since ago
summary: Как сказать, сколько времени что-то длится (**for**), с какого момента (**since**) и сколько времени назад это было (**ago**).
ru:
## for — «в течение»
**for** + **период времени** (сколько длится): three days, two hours, a long time.
> I've lived here **for** five years. — Я живу здесь пять лет.
> We've been waiting **for** an hour. — Мы ждём час.
- ~~since two hours~~ → **for** two hours

## since — «с какого момента»
**since** + **начало периода** (точка на оси времени): Monday, 9 o'clock, 2019, January, I was a child.
> I've lived here **since** 2019. — Я живу здесь с 2019 года.
> We've been waiting **since** 9 o'clock. — Мы ждём с девяти часов.
> She has known him **since** she was ten. — Она знает его с десяти лет.

## Как выбрать: for или since?
| for (период) | since (начало) |
|---|---|
| for three days | since Monday |
| for two years | since 2022 |
| for a long time | since last summer |
| for ten minutes | since 5 o'clock |

Оба слова идут обычно с **present perfect** и отвечают на вопрос **How long?**.

## ago — «назад»
**ago** = «столько-то времени назад» (от сегодняшнего момента). Используем с **past simple**, а не с present perfect.
> I started this job three weeks **ago**. — Я начала эту работу три недели назад.
> When did he leave? — Ten minutes **ago**. — Когда он ушёл? — Десять минут назад.
- ~~I have started three weeks ago.~~ → I **started** three weeks ago.

## Сравнение: ago и for
> When did she arrive? — She arrived three days **ago**. (когда?)
> How long has she been here? — She has been here **for** three days. (как долго?)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I live here since 2020.~~ → I **have lived** here since 2020.
- ~~for Monday~~ → **since** Monday
- ~~since a week~~ → **for** a week
- ~~three days before~~ → three days **ago**
en:
## for
We use **for** + a **period of time** (how long): three days, two hours, a long time.
> I've lived here **for** five years.
> We've been waiting **for** an hour.
- ~~since two hours~~ → **for** two hours

## since
We use **since** + the **start of the period** (a point in time): Monday, 9 o'clock, 2019, January, I was a child.
> I've lived here **since** 2019.
> We've been waiting **since** 9 o'clock.
> She has known him **since** she was ten.

## for or since?
| for (a period) | since (a start) |
|---|---|
| for three days | since Monday |
| for two years | since 2022 |
| for a long time | since last summer |
| for ten minutes | since 5 o'clock |

Both are usually used with the **present perfect** to answer **How long?**.

## ago
**ago** = a period of time before now. We use it with the **past simple**.
> I started this job three weeks **ago**.
> When did he leave? — Ten minutes **ago**.
- ~~I have started three weeks ago.~~ → I **started** three weeks ago.

## Compare ago and for
> When did she arrive? — She arrived three days **ago**.
> How long has she been here? — She has been here **for** three days.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I live here since 2020.~~ → I **have lived** here since 2020.
- ~~for Monday~~ → **since** Monday
- ~~since a week~~ → **for** a week
structure:
## Схема
| Слово | После него | Время глагола | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|
| **for** | период | present perfect | I've lived here **for** two years. |
| **since** | начало | present perfect | I've lived here **since** 2023. |
| **ago** | период (после него ничего) | past simple | I moved here two years **ago**. |

## Что после for
- a minute, ten minutes, an hour, two hours
- a day, three days, a week, a month, six months
- a year, five years, a long time

## Что после since
- день, час: Monday, 7 o'clock, yesterday
- месяц, год: May, 2020
- событие: Christmas, I left school
- предложение: since we met, since I was ten

## Формула
> have / has + past participle + **for** + период
> have / has + past participle + **since** + начало
> past simple + период + **ago**

items.text: Anna has been in Spain {{for}} three days.
I've lived in this house {{since}} 2017.
They have been married {{for}} twenty years.
He has been ill {{since}} Monday.
We've been here {{for}} an hour.
My dad has worked there {{since}} January.
I haven't seen her {{for}} a long time.
It has been raining {{since}} breakfast.

exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения с **ago** (глагол в past simple).
exercises.example: It's 10 o'clock. He left at 9. → He left an hour ago.

items.text: It's Friday. I phoned him on Wednesday. I phoned him two days {{ago}}.
It's 3 p.m. She arrived at 2.30. She arrived half an hour {{ago}}.

It's June. We met in March. We met three months {{ago}}.
It's 7 o'clock. I woke up at 6. I woke up an hour {{ago}}.
It's 20 May. He came on 13 May. He came a week {{ago}}.
